memory.content: Wants an X algorithm expert: keep a local copy of the OSS algo repo and maintain read-only access to X for real-world examples.
Local copy of the X For You algorithm lives at github.com/xai-org/x-algorithm.

Specify github.com/xai-org/x-algorithm as a setup step, include the X plugin (read-only), and define the decision convention: monitor impressions (running total, hourly bars live in Analytics, no claim you have the chart) then quote/ship/wait against published For You weights. It should not include the ephemeral weight table.
Creates content on X (articles + announcements); asked for algo-informed advice on when to self-QT vs post new vs wait while something is going viral.
